original_value: SanDisk Cruzer Glide - USB flash drive - 64 GB. Description: The Cruzer Glide USB flash drive offers an easy and secure way to share, move, and back up your most important files. Featuring a compact design with a retractable USB connector, this flash drive is ideal for data users who need easy, portable access to their media and personal files.
